buff.name: Well-Rested
buff.stacks: Up to 3 Stacks (+1% per minute rested)
buff.maxBonus: +3% Experience from all sources (Monsters AND Quests)
buff.restingSynergy: Resting in the bag counts as Resting in an Inn, accelerating Rested XP velocity.

studentFodder.name: Student Fodder
studentFodder.use: Heals 500 HP immediately + 1,050 over 12s; restores 900 mana / 50 rage / 100 energy (5 min CD, stacks to 30).

questRoadmap.name: ...and that note you found

factionStart.alliance: Alexston Farmstead, Westfall (37.4, 50.6) - Burned-Out Remains in scorched field
factionStart.horde: Field of Giants, The Barrens (46.4, 73.9) - Burned-Out Remains by ruined tower

questRoadmap.task: Click the Burned-Out Remains to loot the traveler's note and initiate the cross-continent trail.
questRoadmap.rewards: Swiftness Potion (+50% speed for 15s) + Lesser Troll's Blood Elixir

questRoadmap.name: Stepping Stones
questRoadmap.location: Opposite Continent's Burned Remains (Barrens for Alliance / Westfall for Horde)
questRoadmap.task: Journey to the enemy continent and turn in the note at the Nailed Plank.
questRoadmap.rewards: 2x 12-Slot Bags (Sturdy Lunchbox & Old Toolbox) + Farmer's Shovel / Mining Pick + Simple Wood & Flint

questRoadmap.name: Scramble & Wet Job
questRoadmap.location: Webwinder Path, Stonetalon Mountains (Path at 50.9, 52.3 -> Camp at 40.7, 52.4 -> Dirt Mound at 39.6, 49.9)
questRoadmap.task: Climb the mountain path north of Sun Rock Retreat, click Pocket Litter at abandoned tent, and jump the ravine to the Mound of Dirt.
questRoadmap.rewards: Choice of Thrown/Ranged Weapon (Silver Star / Moonsight Rifle / Precision Bow) + 4x Student Fodder

questRoadmap.name: Eagle's Fist
questRoadmap.task: Walk onto the dam crest and drop down onto the giant dwarf stone carvings facing the Wetlands to retrieve the Carved Figurine.
questRoadmap.rewards: Hickory Pipe + Rumsey Rum Light (+5 Stamina)

questRoadmap.name: This Must Be The Place
questRoadmap.location: Thoradin's Wall, Hillsbrad / Arathi (87.4, 49.7 Cart -> 22.4, 24.2 Messenger Bag)
questRoadmap.task: Climb the abandoned supply cart south of Durnholde, scale the ramparts, reach the interior room, and click the Hastily Rolled-Up Satchel.
questRoadmap.rewards: Cozy Sleeping Bag (+3% XP for 2 hours) + 8x Student Fodder
